items: The Library of Congress is not aware of any U.S. copyright or any other restrictions in the documents in this collection. Credit Line: Library of Congress, Rare Book and Special Collections Division, Continental Congress & Constitutional Convention Broadsides Collection Availability of Reproductions To inquire about copies of Rare Book and Special Collections Division items, contact the Photoduplication Service (telephone: 202-707-5640).
